Lily of the Valley

Remedy lily-of-the-valley convallaria cardiac-glycoside heart-support edema

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Contains cardiac glycosides that strengthen heart contractions and improve circulation, used cautiously for edema related to heart weakness.

Indications

  • edema
  • heart failure
  • arrhythmia
  • circulatory insufficiency

Contraindications

  • pregnancy
  • breastfeeding
  • children
  • electrolyte imbalance
  • kidney disease

Preparations

  • standardized extract only

Body Systems Affected

  • cardiovascular
  • circulatory
  • renal

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
  • Kidney Issues
    Kidney dysfunction affecting fluid balance and waste filtration, leading to fluid retention, edema, and metabolic imbalances.
